name: Visual Dialog
description: Visual Dialog is a benchmark that measures an AI agent's ability to hold a meaningful dialog about visual content. Given an image, dialog history, and a question, the agent must ground the question in the image, infer context from history, and answer accurately. It includes a large-scale dataset with 1.4M dialog question-answer pairs and uses a retrieval-based evaluation protocol.
reputation: One of the first large-scale benchmarks for visual dialog, widely cited and used in multimodal research.
notes: Dataset contains dialogs on ~140k images from COCO with 10 QA pairs per dialog; evaluation is retrieval-based sorting candidate answers.
